m322_minus_m314.interpretation: The pipeline removes 99 logic levels and recovers the pre-macro setup gate while adding 108 sequential cells. Its 1.19 percent area reduction is genuine in this DC run but flow- and hold-fix-sensitive because M322 contains 311 delay cells.

findings.observation: M322 reports hold MET by only 0.0001 ns (0.1 ps) after insertion of 311 DEL025/DEL075 cells occupying 203.741995 um2. The run uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload, zero macros and no extracted parasitics.
findings.impact: Technical pre-macro hold is reportable, but it has no credible physical robustness. Clock-tree skew, routing, OCV or the eventual SRAM interface can erase the margin; it cannot support a physical-frequency or paper-PPA claim.
findings.required_fix: Run propagated-clock post-placement or post-route STA with extracted parasitics and the target center-memory boundary. Resolve hold with physical clock/data optimization, then reseal setup and hold together.

findings.observation: Production SVA observes stage0_valid but not the internal stage0 payload and does not directly assert occupancy conservation, stage0 payload stability during a full stall, simultaneous retire/shift/accept ordering, or empty-stage0 absorption behind a stalled output.
findings.impact: The producer scoreboard, 3000-transaction replay and independent directed VCS cover these behaviors, so admission is not blocked; however, future payload-path edits have less local assertion protection than the protocol deserves.
findings.required_fix: Bind internal stage payload/valid state or expose verification-only taps and add conservation, full-stall payload stability, simultaneous push/pop ordering and empty-stage0 absorption properties to production SVA.

findings.observation: The M322 logic-only area is 1.192 percent below M314, but the comparison includes 311 inserted delay cells in M322 versus 15 in M314 and remains ideal-clock/ZeroWireload/macro-free.
findings.impact: The numeric delta is reproducible but sensitive to synthesis hold-fix choices and should not be promoted to a physical-area advantage or headline.
findings.required_fix: Retain only the bounded logic-only number until both designs are compared in the same physical flow with clocks, routes, SRAM boundaries and identical hold methodology.

admitted: Exact-SHA M321 matcher semantics: minimum Hamming choice over sixteen centers, minimum packed unsigned center tie break, population-below-two guard, tau0 exact-only and tau1 distance-zero/one
M321 two-stage elastic boundary preserves order and payload under backpressure, has two-cycle no-stall latency, and sustains module-boundary II=1 with continuous downstream readiness
M322 pre-macro logic-only setup architecture gate: setup slack 1.1047 ns and 36 logic levels against the frozen 0.5 ns/60-level gate
M322 bounded logic-only DC facts: 1942.541962 um2 standard-cell area, 2496 leaf cells, 156 sequential cells, zero macros and five clean constraint classes
not_admitted: Robust physical hold closure, 3 ns post-route timing or 333 MHz physical operation
Physical center SRAM, its ports, latency, area, bandwidth or energy
SAIF power, energy or paper-ready PPA
DATE comparison, headline or best-paper claim
